user_query: I'm preparing a presentation on effective communication skills and I need some TED talks to reference. Can you recommend some speakers and fetch their details using the TED Talks API? Additionally, fetch some articles from Pluralsight.com to provide further insights on communication techniques.

TaskList.description: Fetch a list of TED talks related to effective communication skills.
From the TED talks list, select a few notable speakers and fetch their detailed profiles.
Search Pluralsight.com for articles related to communication techniques.
